Locals told me stolen pets end up here at this black market, but that was only the beginning of what I found inside Karachi's infamous Sunday Pet Market.

Every Sunday, traders, breeders, collectors, performers, and animal enthusiasts gather in a maze of streets and alleyways behind the Rainbow Centre in Saddar, Karachi, Pakistan, to buy, sell, and display a huge variety of animals.

In this video, I go undercover inside this black market to see what is really happening behind the scenes.

⚠️ This video does not encourage the purchase, sale, or exploitation of animals. It is a documentary exploration of a real place and the people who visit it. Please consider adopting animals from your local animal shelter.
